title: fix(app-shell): permission-set editor header shows the served (translated) label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GKuALbng1TQyrFASUX9Lyy)_
Fixes #26884

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:权限集详情页(Setup 与 Studio 访问支柱)的标题改用服务端按语言下发的标签,zh-CN 下显示「销售代表」而不是「Sales Representative」。
- **为什么改**:列表页已经显示翻译后的名称,点进去标题却是英文原文;编辑器的草稿来自未翻译的 layered 读取,而它已经读到的已发布列表是翻译过的。
- **风险与回滚**:只改显示,草稿与保存内容不变(保存仍发作者原文);标签被编辑或有不同标签的待发布草稿时显示草稿标签。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- **先看**:`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的 `headerLabel` 与加载末尾读取 served 行那段;新测试 `PermissionMatrixEditor.servedLabel-26884.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.servedLabel-26884.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `PermissionMatrixEditPage` keeps the label of the row `GET /meta/permission` serves for this set (that read is localized at the REST boundary by the server's permission-set translator, and the editor already makes it for the published-set check). The header shows it while the draft's label equals the published authored label; otherwise it shows the draft's label, as before.
- Both header sites read it: the Setup page's identity strip and the Studio Access pillar's `StudioItemHeader` title.
- Display only: the served label is never written into `draft`, so a save sends the authored label unchanged. A set the published list does not hold (never published) keeps its draft label.
- Scope cut, per the dispatch order: the card's second symptom (the metadata list chrome staying English under ja-JP / es-ES) is the ruled en fallback, not a defect (Ruling-ref 6431032267, verbatim: "the other eight locales fall back to en (no invented translations)"), so it is not touched here.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

New `PermissionMatrixEditor.servedLabel-26884.test.tsx` (4 cases): zh-CN served 销售代表 over layered "Sales Representative", and the autosave sends "Sales Representative" unchanged; ja-JP served label; a set the list does not hold keeps its draft label; an edit to the label shows the edit.

Ablation (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob equals HEAD): putting `draft.label` back in the Setup header turns 3 of the 4 cases red (the never-published case stays green, as expected); restored, 4/4 green.

## Acceptance notes

- The served label comes from the same list request the editor already sends; no new request.
